description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Clone' which is an extension of 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef'. It acts as a wrapper to clone another attribute definition object and delegate validation to it, while providing a method to clone the attribute definition object itself.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Clone
classes.description: A dummy attribute definition class that clones another attribute definition object and delegates validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a clone of another attribute definition object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Delegates validation to the wrapped clone object.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates and returns a clone of the wrapped attribute definition object.
